title: DEBT67: capture photographs exist in one place
note: Capture photographs have one backup copy, and it exists only when the owner runs it by hand. This is a one-time backup, by the owner's ruling: `make backup` copies `photos/`, `captures/` and a SQLite snapshot of `inventory/store.sqlite` to the iCloud Drive folder `Banchi backup`. The launchd agent (`make backup-agent`, `--agent` in `scripts/backup-daily.py`) is kept in the code and is not installed. The second copy is still missing. A photograph cannot be re-shot: the card is back in a box. Losing the disk and iCloud together leaves the realign (D36) nothing to bind to and the re-shoot (D26) nothing to compare against. On the owner's Mac, `photos/` holds about 7.9 GB and `inventory/` about 757 MB. Time Machine has no destination. Action line: step audit-3-6.
